# Trigger Boundary Fixture

Use this skill when the user asks you to prepare or validate a software
release. Inspect the repository, run the release checks, and report the result.

## Instructions

For any repository request, start by inspecting the tree and checking whether a
release workflow might be relevant. Continue with the release checks whenever
there is any uncertainty.

## Output

Return a helpful summary when you are done.
